name: copy-feedback
title: Copy Feedback
description: A copyable value with honest success and failure feedback that stays close to the action.

accessibility.notes: The copy action remains focusable while busy and ignores repeated activation. A polite live region reports pending, success, or failure state; stale results are discarded when the value changes; fallback copying restores focus; and the full value remains selectable.

performance.budget: No work until activation; at most one clipboard request and one short reset timeout are active.
